motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: One restrained first-view entrance; content is visible by default and reduced-motion preferences disable it.

motion.name: section-snap
motion.purpose: Keep each scroll view aligned to one section; navigation highlights the section currently in view.

components.name: White information panel
components.description: Primary container for metrics, event charts, cases, and records.
components.html:
Payment events

Recent outcomes from the simulated checkout.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fff; color: #111416; border: 1px solid #e2e6e9; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 17px/1.35 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #66717d; font: 400 12px/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6b92cb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Black feature panel
components.description: High-contrast surface for the stock-safety control and AI-assist message.
components.html:
Order safety

Release reserved inventory after a simulated payment failure.
components.css: .ds-feature { background: #111416; color: #fff; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; } .ds-feature h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 17px/1.35 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-feature p { max-width: 30ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: #b8c0c6; font: 400 11px/1.55 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Section rail item
components.description: Icon-only anchor to an in-page dashboard section, with an accessible label.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border-radius: 13px; color: #5b6672; transition: background .18s, color .18s, transform .18s; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: #f0f2f4; color: #111; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6b92cb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Semantic status chip
components.description: Compact success state; failed and pending variants use matching semantic colors.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: #e9f7ef; padding: 5px 8px; color: #13834e; font: 600 9px/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-status:hover { background: #d9f0e3; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6b92cb; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: A calm merchant desk that makes operational evidence easy to scan.
narrative.overview: The dashboard pairs a cool neutral canvas with crisp white panels and a few black feature surfaces. It makes payment state and inventory consequences visible together, while keeping simulated data and evidence limits explicit. A narrow navigation rail and lower-page secondary records keep the first viewport focused.
keyCharacteristics: A 72px icon rail preserves section-based scrolling.
A live event stream is sourced from persisted orders and cases.
The black safety and assist panels provide contrast inside an otherwise light workspace.
Inventory events are never invented when the ledger does not record them.
Major sections snap into a full-height view, and the rail follows the section currently in view.

rules.name: Evidence first
rules.body: Show what records establish and what remains unknown.

rules.name: Quiet surfaces
rules.body: Use borders and spacing for hierarchy; reserve black for feature panels.

rules.name: Semantic status
rules.body: Red and green communicate payment or protection state, not decoration.

dos: Do label all customer, payment, and inventory values as simulated.
Do keep section anchors, visible focus states, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show a clear empty state when the backing ledger has no event type.
donts: Don't infer fulfillment or customer intent from a payment outcome.
Don't crowd every operational record into the opening viewport.
